the expression of 5 miRNAs (miR-125a-5p, miR-125b-5p, let-7a-5p and let-7c-5p and miR-30a-5p) is significantly downregulated in SPN compared to pancreatic cancer, and that these miRNAs can be used to differentiate SPN from pancreatic cancer with a high degree of accuracy.

the gene expression of the 3 genes, namely CYP3A4, CYP4F3, and CYP4F2, was significantly higher in the pancreatic cancer tissues compared to normal pancreatic tissues, and these 3 genes were identified to be potential biomarkers of the pancreatic cancer.

we developed an integrated gene regulatory network model that can be used to predict the risk of pancreatic malignancies and SPN, and to identify biomarkers for differential diagnosis between these diseases.
